title: Solvability atlas score check
summary: The atlas solvability score contains the outcome it describes, so it carries no forecast.
plot_title: Solvability atlas: AUC of each feature against resolved, 71 problems, in-sample
discussion: The score is 0.55 times the resolved flag plus 0.45 times the formal status, so it separates the 15 resolved problems from the 56 open ones with no error by construction. The formal term records the outcome too: all 10 problems with a Lean proof are resolved. Of the features known before a resolution, year posed gives 0.35 and market count 0.38. Level gives 0.72 and was set with hindsight. Next: freeze a dated forecast and score it later.
image_alt: Bars of AUC: score 1.00, formal term 0.88, level 0.72, market count 0.38, year posed 0.35
